__doc: Attribute-name modifier suffix vocabulary. THE source of truth for the `modifier_suffixes` table (Spec 31 §4). db_lookup._migrate_modifier_suffixes() seeds from this file at module load.
__why: Had NO writer anywhere, yet is CONVERTER-LOAD-BEARING: read at db_lookup.py:585, :2146 (kind='breakpoint') and :2262. A rebuild-from-empty produced 0 rows, which silently breaks breakpoint/side resolution. Captured from live 2026-08-02.
__ORDER_IS_LOAD_BEARING: db_lookup.py:2262 selects `WHERE kind = ? ORDER BY rowid`, so the order of this list IS the order the resolver sees. `side` is Top/Right/Bottom/Left — CSS shorthand order. __format: [suffix, kind, notes] — ORDERED list, not a mapping
